newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pacific Bank still in insurance deal.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Bank still in insurance deal.

text.p: Pacific Bank Bhd said on Friday that the termination of discussions with Oversea Chinese Banking Corp on a merger with its Malaysian branch will not affect ongoing talks about OCBC's insurance unit.

Pacific Bank had been involved in a proposed merger with OCBC Bank (Malaysia) Bhd as well as the purchase of a significant equity stake in the restructured operations of OCBC's Great Eastern Life Assurance Co Ltd in Malaysia.
The termination of merger talks with OCBC Bank in Malaysia "will not affect the on-going discussions with The Great Eastern Life Assurance Co Ltd", a statement from Pacific Bank said.

Pacific Bank said it understands that the insurance company "remains committed" to restructruing its business in Malaysia and said that both parties hope to complete their discussions "in the near future" for submission to Malaysian and Singaporean authorities for approval.
Earlier, OCBC announced that the proposed merger between its Malaysia unit and Pacific Bank had been terminated due to various complex issues regarding legal, accounting and regulatory requirements.
In its statement on Friday, Pacific said its activities and operations would not be affected by the termination of the merger talks.
OCBC made a similar statement about the operations of its bank in Malaysia.
